XSUP Auditor & KCS Generator

v1.0 · Initial Team Release

Retrospective review and direct KCS generation for XDR/XSIAM, XSOAR and Cortex Cloud.

Open an authenticated TACO pageUse TACO Pilot, an individual case page, or another valid page under https://taco.paloaltonetworks.com:3009/taco/.

Manual bookmark installation
Create a new bookmarkRight-click the Chrome bookmarks bar and choose Add page.
Name it XSUP AuditorUse any name you prefer, but keeping XSUP Auditor makes it easy to identify.
Copy the bookmark URLClick Copy Bookmark URL above and paste the complete value into the bookmark URL field.
Save and runOpen any authenticated TACO page under /taco/, then click the new bookmark.

Run the JavaScript directly

This option is useful when you prefer a Chrome DevTools Snippet instead of a bookmark.

Open an authenticated TACO pageUse TACO Pilot, an individual case page, or another valid page under https://taco.paloaltonetworks.com:3009/taco/.
Open Chrome DevToolsOpen Sources → Snippets, then create a new snippet named XSUP Auditor.
Paste the complete JavaScriptUse Copy JS above, or open the file saved by Download JS and copy its full contents into the snippet.
Run the snippetPress ⌘ + Enter on macOS or Ctrl + Enter on Windows while the TACO PILOT page is active.
Direct JS is not a bookmark installation. Run the snippet again after a page/session where the Auditor is no longer loaded.

Workflows

Audit-first knowledge routing & standalone auto-download

The validated Audit is the primary routing decision. Default Browser Downloads requests the retrospective Audit HTML first. Only after that Audit download is initiated are the Audit-selected Knowledge artifacts queued. The Audit can select CREATE KCS, UPDATE EXISTING KCS, Admin/Tech Guide, Runbook, Known Issue/Release Note, or no Knowledge action after inspecting available existing KCS/docs/pages/prior evidence. Each selected Knowledge artifact then auto-downloads as its own standalone HTML. The current release preserves validated Audit-led routing in retrospective mode. Direct Generate KCS remains the intentional KCS-family exception and can reconcile CREATE to UPDATE EXISTING KCS after actual existing-KCS content inspection.

Run XSUP Retrospective

Reviews the applicable Support-owned retrospective fields from the original case evidence, creates the case-specific audit/management learning, and generates reusable knowledge artifacts when justified.

Generate KCS

Accepts XSUP and/or SFDC directly, skips the retrospective field-review prompt, and generates only the KCS-family artifact. Existing Salesforce KCS content is compared before recommending CREATE versus UPDATE. When UPDATE is recommended, the reviewer can still choose Create New KCS Anyway; the separate new draft keeps the related existing KCS referenced for duplication/conflict review.

Accepted inputs

XSUP-12345
04001234
XSUP-12345 / 04001234

Enter multiple jobs on separate lines. An 8-digit Salesforce case number can be supplied directly. A supplied XSUP/SFDC pair is kept as one job. When automatic XSUP → SFDC resolution is unavailable, the Auditor provides manual SFDC entry without restarting the job.

The bookmark runs only on the exact authenticated TACO scope: https://taco.paloaltonetworks.com:3009/taco/. TACO Pilot, case pages, and other paths under /taco/ are supported.
Validation required for generated outputs. Audit, KCS, Runbook, Admin/Tech Guide and related generated drafts are review aids, not authoritative product sources. Cases, KCS articles, Jira/XSUP findings, Confluence/runbooks, web documentation and AI-assisted synthesis can be historical, version-specific, superseded or inaccurate. Validate material technical claims and current-release applicability against maintained sources or current SME/Engineering evidence before publication or authoritative reuse. Inline REVIEW/BLOCKER callouts identify the affected claim/reference, why it needs validation, and the required action.
